name: flowstitch
description: Your notes and tasks, seamlessly connected.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run guidelines
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests docs scripts/*.mjs *.json *.css *.mjs *.ts README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests docs scripts/*.mjs *.json *.css *.mjs *.ts README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
